extraction_quality_notes: Blind extraction intentionally omits expected_manifold, expected_manifolds, disease_label_per_paper, final diagnosis, and paper-title-derived diagnosis fields.
All rankable axes are diagnosis-neutral generic clinical observations; no ordinary *_in_D-* observation axes are used.
Treatment, noninvasive ventilation response, final interpretation, late outcome, and discussion-level causal framing are record-only.
Case 1 blood tests are reported only as unremarkable; no individual analytes, troponin, BNP, creatinine, or blood gas values are provided.
SpO2 is measured while using high-flow oxygen mask, so room-air hypoxemia severity is ambiguous.
The phrase acute dyspnea provides no exact symptom duration.
Pulmonary edema imaging is qualitative; the source gives no edema score, B-line count, pleural effusion status, or cardiac size measurement.
